description: This is a C# source file defining a static class 'ManageNavPages' that provides helper methods and constants for managing navigation page states in an ASP.NET Core MVC web application. The class helps determine which navigation item is active based on the current view context.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static utility class providing constants and methods to assist with navigation page highlighting and management in the manage section of the web application.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class for the Index page navigation link based on the current view context.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines whether the navigation item should be marked as active based on the current view context and target page.

methods.description: Extension method for ViewDataDictionary to set the current active page.
